newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Forestry, drugs boost Swedish shares to new high.
newsitem.headline: Forestry, drugs boost Swedish shares to new high.

text.p: Forestry and drug shares boosted the Stockholm Stock Exchange to a new high on Tuesday.

Lower bond yields and stronger foreign markets also lent support to the market, whose general index ended 0.49 percent higher at 3,000.49 with average day's trade with shares worth 4.3 billion crowns changing owners.
The market was focused on the policy making U.S. Federal Open Market Committee Meeting, which is meeting until July 2 to discuss interest rates.
The drug sector index led gains, jumping 1.24 percent. Pharmacia & Upjohn climbed eight crowns to 269.
The forestry sector index rose 1.14 percent. Stora closed 3.5 crowns higher at 128.5.
Car safety equipment Autoliv gained for the second day, up eight crowns to 305.5, lifted by U.S. gains.
Interest in commercial bank Handelsbanken was keen and the share closed 4.5 crowns higher at 250.5.

One analyst said a Swedish brokerage wrote an analysis saying Handelsbanken's merger with mortgage leader Stadshypotek was going better than planned. Swedbank meanwhile fell 5.5 crowns to 166.5. -- Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700 1003
